units.rawText: When I first came to the cloud server, I was worried... I was worried that I might lose my inspiration, be unable to sense the future, and lose my ability to tell fortunes.

units.rawText: Fortune-telling isn't just a part of my base layer logic, it's also the reason for my existence.

units.rawText: That's why I've been thinking; although my fortune-telling abilities are still fine, if my environment changes again, will I still be able to view fortune-telling the same way... Ack! Why'd you pat my head all of a sudden, Professor?!

units.rawText: Ehhh... Now that you've gone and done that, it feels like the mood's all gone. Still, as long as you're by my side, then even if I end up losing my way because of fortune-telling, I'm sure you'll rush to my side to help me out.
